title: One-Pan Eggs & Vegetable Hash
description: Crispy potatoes and peppers cooked with butter and thyme, topped with baked eggs in one pan.
ingredients: 1/2 each yellow and red pepper, chunked
steps: Boil the potatoes 8 minutes, then drain.
Fry the vegetables and potatoes in oil and butter until browning, then add spring onion, garlic and thyme.
Make gaps in the pan, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 4 minutes.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food one-pan egg & veg brunch

notes: One pan, minimal cleanup — a good weekend option when you want a bigger cooked breakfast without the effort.
